description: Environment setup + baseline verification + B2B role/department foundation. Confirm the toolchain builds green, then wire the new 'b2b' department/category into the existing auth/role architecture WITHOUT touching any existing module behaviour. This is the foundation every later phase depends on: the b2b AppRole, the enum migration, nav scaffolding gate, and the shared src/lib/b2b.ts constants module. No new business tables yet.
steps: Set up and confirm baseline: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; cd /projects/sandbox/Easemyoffice; bun install --frozen-lockfile; npx tsc --noEmit (expect clean); bun run test (expect 131 passed / 10 files); bun run build (expect success emitting dist/server). Record the baseline numbers.

Create migration supabase/migrations/20260517000001_b2b_role.sql containing ONLY `ALTER TYPE public.app_role ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'b2b';` with a comment explaining Postgres requires a new enum value to be committed in its own transaction before any later migration/policy can reference it. This migration MUST have the earliest B2B timestamp so it is applied first.
Add 'b2b' to the AppRole union in src/lib/auth.tsx: `export type AppRole = "admin" | "sales" | "documentation" | "accounts" | "renewals" | "bd" | "b2b";`.

Add "b2b" to ROLE_OPTIONS in src/routes/_authenticated/admin/users.tsx so admins can assign the B2B role when creating/managing users (the user manages users themselves). Keep the array order sensible (e.g. add after 'renewals').

Create src/lib/b2b.ts as the shared B2B constants/types module following the src/lib/crm.ts style. Export: B2B_LEAD_STATUSES (New Prospect, Data Verified, First Contact, Contacted, Interested, Meeting Scheduled, Meeting Completed, Partnership Discussion, Partner Onboarded, First Referral, Active Partner, Not Interested, No Response, Wrong Number, Duplicate, Bad Data, Do Not Contact, Lost) each with {id,label,color}; B2B_PIPELINE_STAGES (the 10 ordered pipeline stages: New Prospect, Data Verified, First Contact, Contacted, Interested, Meeting/Discussion, Partnership Discussion, Partner Onboarded, First Referral, Active Partner) with a separate closed/lost outcome set; B2B_SOURCES default list (Google, Google Maps, CA Directory, Website, Referral, LinkedIn, Other) noting sources are configurable/not hardcoded downstream; FIRM_TYPES and FIRM_SIZES; PARTNER_HEALTH categories (Strategic Partner, Active Partner, Potential, Dormant, Lost); REFERRAL_STATUSES (New, Assigned, Contacted, Qualified, Converted, Lost, Invalid); ACTIVITY_TYPES (call, whatsapp, email, meeting, task, followup, note). Also export a labelFor-style helper or reuse crm.ts labelFor. Add src/lib/b2b.test.ts with unit tests for any pure helper (e.g. stage ordering / labelFor lookups).

Create a src/lib/b2b-db.ts (or add to b2b.ts) exporting `b2bDb = () => supabase as any` mirroring hrmsDb() in src/lib/hrms.ts, with a clear comment that B2B tables are not in generated types.ts (no Supabase creds in sandbox) so these queries are unchecked and the hand-written row types are the contract. Hand-written row types will be filled in as tables are added in later phases; for now export the helper and a placeholder for the types that follow.

Add the B2B sidebar SECTION scaffold to src/components/app-shell.tsx so the department is visible, but only wire links to routes that will exist after this phase — for FEAT-001 add a single top-level 'B2B Dashboard' placeholder entry gated to roles ['admin','b2b'] pointing at a route you create as a stub (src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/index.tsx) that renders a simple 'B2B' heading using existing Card components. Full nested nav is added in FEAT-002+. Ensure visibleFor() logic still shows admin everything and does not alter any existing entry.

Create the stub route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/index.tsx guarded with guardRoles(queryClient, ['admin','b2b']) in beforeLoad (follow the pattern used by other guarded routes), rendering a minimal placeholder page. Rebuild so src/routeTree.gen.ts regenerates and commit it.
Run prettier on every new file; confirm no new eslint errors on touched existing files (compare per-file counts).
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, `bun run test` passes (>=131 tests, including new b2b.test.ts), `bun run build` succeeds and regenerates src/routeTree.gen.ts.
Migration 20260517000001_b2b_role.sql exists, is idempotent, and adds only the 'b2b' enum value.
AppRole in src/lib/auth.tsx includes 'b2b' and users.tsx ROLE_OPTIONS includes 'b2b'.
src/lib/b2b.ts exports all listed constant sets and compiles; b2bDb() escape-hatch exists.
A guarded /b2b route renders and a B2B sidebar section is visible to admin and b2b-role users only, with no change to how existing nav items render for existing roles.
No existing migration, table, route, or module behaviour was modified.
verification: Confirm git diff shows src/routeTree.gen.ts regenerated and the new /b2b route registered.
findings: Baseline confirmed green at start: npx tsc --noEmit clean, bun run test = 131 passed / 10 files, bun run build ok (~12s). After implementation: tsc clean, bun run test = 138 passed / 11 files (added src/lib/b2b.test.ts with 7 tests), bun run build ok and regenerated src/routeTree.gen.ts (new /b2b route registered). Delivered: (1) migration supabase/migrations/20260517000001_b2b_role.sql = single idempotent `ALTER TYPE public.app_role ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'b2b';` (earliest B2B timestamp, own transaction per Postgres enum rule). (2) 'b2b' added to AppRole union in src/lib/auth.tsx and to ROLE_OPTIONS in admin/users.tsx (after 'renewals'). (3) src/lib/b2b.ts (crm.ts style) exporting B2B_LEAD_STATUSES (18), B2B_PIPELINE_STAGES (10 ordered + order field), B2B_CLOSED_OUTCOMES, B2B_SOURCES (default/configurable), FIRM_TYPES, FIRM_SIZES, PARTNER_HEALTH, REFERRAL_STATUSES, ACTIVITY_TYPES, plus labelFor/pipelineStageOrder/isClosedOutcome helpers and the b2bDb() = `supabase as any` escape-hatch (mirrors hrmsDb(); row types are placeholder, filled in FEAT-002+). (4) stub route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/index.tsx guarded via guardRoles(queryClient, ['admin','b2b']) rendering a Card placeholder. (5) 'B2B Dashboard' NAV entry in app-shell.tsx gated to ['admin','b2b'] (Handshake icon); MobileTabBar derives from the same array automatically. GOTCHAS for later phases: (a) users.tsx inserts into user_roles needed `role: ... as never` casts because the generated types.ts user_roles enum does NOT include 'b2b' (no Supabase creds to regenerate) - use this cast pattern for any B2B role writes. (b) Keep per-file edits surgical: running `npx prettier --write` on existing files (app-shell.tsx, users.tsx) reformats the WHOLE file producing huge diffs since the repo carries thousands of pre-existing prettier errors; format only your new lines by hand. (c) Verified no NEW eslint errors on touched files (per-file counts unchanged vs base: app-shell 13/13, users 80/80, auth 0/0). (d) ROLE_OPTIONS had to be split multiline so the added 'b2b' did not push line 20 over print width.
